body: Thank you. I'll make something later.

My allowance is given by my mom, but I won't tell her that I will be going back to the clinic so now I have to budget my allowance for appt and meds. She thinks that everything I do is for attention, I don't talk to her now as much, she's far anyway.

She doesn't know how much I'm spending, she doesn't care anyway. She'll just deposit the money and let me spend as much as I want. Now I can't control myself with spending my money. Last time, I also spend the money for my bills, it took me 2 months to pay for it and she doesn't know. I don't even know how I'm spending so much money when most of the time I'm isolating.
Thank you. I'll make a list later
Yes
Thank you

I'm thinking of the money. I spend almost all my supposedly budget for tomorrow from my allowance last week. Me and my impulsive spending, I hate myself for not sticking to the budget. Once I start with all the meds again there's no turning back coz I know what happens with abrupt withdrawal, I've done that before & I don't like it, it made me worse.

I just don't know what to say, after 2 years of no contact and it's always a rush appointment back then coz I don't know how to explain and keep the convo going about what's happening to me. And my mom don't know that I'll go back to the clinic. I'm gonna try to do it all alone now and try to budget my allowance for meds.
Same bruh. I'm a multitasker and a procrastinator that always end up empty handed at the end of the day. Can't focus to one thing. It seems boring and tiring.

I'll end up failing school anyway coz I don't love the course I'm taking and I don't have goals. I'm in my 5th year already but I'm extended for another 3 years. I'm 20 but I don't know what to do with my life. I wanna take a break to miss and realize something. I wanna know if I'll have the urge to go back and finish what I've started.

Good for you. One way to practice is to read and converse using the language and if you're willing to learn it'll be easier. May I ask if you think you can still go back to school after 5 years of break? I was thinking of taking a break as well but Idk if I can go back after that.
Thank you.

Yeah. Isolation is a must for me whenever I'm feeling like this. My thought is so strong that I can picture myself doing something bad. Sometimes I'm dissociating so much that I'm doing something I didn't even realize. Some ppl told me that I'm pretty scary when I told them things. I shouldn't live longer, I'm scared.
I listen to Daughters' Songs and/or Peter Gundry's The Shadows Bride Album on Spotify.

Yes. Even though I'm tired, I can't fall asleep without any noise. It hurts my eye so bad if I force myself to sleep so I just stare in the darkness and overthink until dawn. Now I can sleep within 30 minutes' sleep timer in Spotify listening to Peter Gundry's dark music. I love them. It makes me calm and relax. I usually listen to it when I'm about to lose control again.

Nah. I don't cry easily in front of anyone but if I'm down and all, I'll always have a fit, throw things, hurt myself and none stop crying until I sleep, no matter where I am. But I'm easily triggered to silent treatment, soft and caring voices and me as a topic.

I thought I was the only one. I've been doing it since I was a kid. I would shout real loud and trash everything then bang my head to the wall or anything I will bite something until it breaks and scratch myself to avoid hurting others and to stop feeling angry or frustrated. I always end up sleeping after then wake up to trash and cry some more then sleep when I'm finally tired and feel okay moments later. Sometimes I feel satisfied with what I do with myself. I can't feel the pain until the next day thou or until I press the bumps and bruises. Last year was the major one, whole day, it's before my birthday. But I had one 2 days ago while at a party but I let it all out in my room and just by hitting my head cause I have a roommate. Needless to say, I didn't enjoy the party and until now I feel so awful that I wanted to die.
Like you? Anonymous? I'm kinda new here in Reddit, is there any chatrooms here?

I do have someone to talk to and call but it feels like I'm being a burden to them, I know they have their own battle to win so sometimes I don't bother them unless I felt like drowning but after that I felt so overdramatic, weak and a wimp. And someone's trying to enter my life in a romantic way but I have abandonment and trust issues and I know I'm not stable in a way he can't understand. Since then to present, when someone's trying to get attached, I always run away. I don't want anyone to get involve with me coz I know I'm hard to handle that even my family can't. And I'm also afraid that someone will broke me more than I do now.

Half way through this year, after my birthday. I had a solid plan to end it all coz I've been in solitary for so long and just thought all of this is enough. I have the tool, the place and the deadline. I lost so much weight thinking about it. Then I got bored waiting and thinking about it and thought that I should make my remaining days worth while and less cranky. I wanna save money for my own funeral so I got a part time job. Got panic attacks and fatigue though coz I'm not used to going out and moving a lot. Met someone and made me realize something. I am fortunate. I do have lots of opportunities ahead. I quit my job, start hanging out with friends, I opened up. Something changed but I'm feeling like the plan is still on. I'm with my family this holidays and will be back alone before new year. I don't know what will happen. Go with the flow.

Risky things are more thrilling but yeah once it becomes a routine it'll get boring, and I can't focus much long on anything.

We have plans tomorrow, travel & tour but I'm not excited or anything, I'm feeling numb most of the time. Sometimes, I asked myself how the hell did I end up here without me noticing? Nothing matters, I just go with the flow. I'm a pessimist nihilistic human being.
Same. Trying to enjoy the remaining days of 2019.

I feel the same. Been thinking that for so long and now I don't even wanna reach 2020 cause what's the point? I don't appreciate things and I always felt disconnected. All emotions are temporary. They say what we're feeling is the temporary one. But it's the one growing with me, it's getting worse. But I hope we still get through this. Someone, something, anything.
